parameters.name: ChildInstanceRegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the network instance.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to query region IDs.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceRouteTableId
parameters.description: The route table ID of the network instance.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the network instance. Valid values: 

- **VPC**: virtual private cloud.

- **VBR**: virtual border router.

- **CCN**: Cloud Connect Network.

parameters.name: DestinationCidrBlock
parameters.description: The destination CIDR block of the route entry to query.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: **10**. Valid values: **1** to **500**.
